features.summary: FusionInPlaceEditor: one declaration of the Syncfusion InPlaceEditor by its JavaScript names, each named as EJ2 names it, value, disabled, enableEditMode, save and its element's classList, each EJ2 33.1.47's public member; the payloads of its seven events, nested in the declaration under EJ2's names, each as the browser hands it; the input it is, generic over the member it binds, so its value and change's value and previousValue read the member's own type, the kind each editor type hands (M21.X404); and the render helper that renders it bound to a model member. Main spreads the slice over twelve files whose calls name members by strings over ComponentRef, payload classes with setters, extensions that take the pipeline and a Reactive extension on the vendor's builder; the redesign declares it in one file, the shape the rewrite keeps, with no call of a private member (M21.X402), a starting value read with no compile (M21.X403) and its value typed by the bound member.

sentences.text: public sealed class FusionInPlaceEditor : FusionComponent, IInputComponent
public ReadOnly<TResponse> Data<TResponse>() where TResponse : class => ReadOnly<TResponse>();

FusionInPlaceEditor<TValue> is generic over the member it binds: its render helper renders it with the member's type, so Value, a Property<TValue>, the input M7.N3 builds from it, and change's Value and PreviousValue read and write the member's own type, as main reads the value by the member the field registers (Alis.Reactive.Fusion/Components/FusionInPlaceEditor/FusionInPlaceEditorExtensions.cs:111-115 at 623dd4a27): text for a Text editor, a number for Numeric, a DateTime for Date, a DateTime[] of its two days for DateRange and a list of the items' values for MultiSelect, the kind EJ2 hands each (probe:ej2-inplaceeditor-change-Text, probe:ej2-inplaceeditor-change-Numeric, probe:ej2-inplaceeditor-change-Date, probe:ej2-inplaceeditor-change-DateRange, probe:ej2-inplaceeditor-change-MultiSelect); pipeline.Input(m => m.Member) reads it as a BoundInput of the same type (N14.4).

FusionInPlaceEditor<TValue> declares the EJ2 InPlaceEditor by its JavaScript names: value as Value; disabled as Disabled and enableEditMode as EnableEditMode, a Property<bool> each; save as Save; and its element's classList add and remove as Element.ClassList.Add and Remove; each EJ2 33.1.47's public member (@syncfusion/ej2-inplace-editor/src/inplace-editor/base/inplace-editor.d.ts:187, :320, :336, :587; @syncfusion/ej2-base/src/component.d.ts:17). EJ2's private disable and setFocus (inplace-editor.d.ts:541, :525) are declared by no door: Disabled disables and enables the editor, and EnableEditMode set true opens it and focuses its input unless beginEdit's cancelFocus is set (@syncfusion/ej2-inplace-editor/src/inplace-editor/base/inplace-editor.js:1319-1320, :799-803, :1046-1053) (M21.X402).

BeginEdit, EndEdit, Change, ActionBegin, ActionSuccess, SubmitClick and CancelClick hand payloads nested in FusionInPlaceEditor<TValue> under EJ2's names, BeginEditEventArgs, EndEditEventArgs, ChangeEventArgs, ActionBeginEventArgs, ActionEventArgs and, for the two clicks, MouseEvent, read with Read: beginEdit's cancel, cancelFocus and mode, and endEdit's action, cancel and mode, each optional as @syncfusion/ej2-inplace-editor/src/inplace-editor/base/interface.d.ts:86-107 marks it; change's Value and PreviousValue, the bound member's type; actionBegin's data, the submission's name, primaryKey and value, each text for every editor type (probe:ej2-inplaceeditor-action-begin-values), and its cancel, optional (:47-57); actionSuccess's data as Data<TResponse>() and its value (:58-68); and the name of each, which EJ2's observer sets on every payload it hands a listener (@syncfusion/ej2-base/src/observer.js:92, probe:ej2-payload-inplaceeditor-beginEdit, probe:ej2-payload-inplaceeditor-endEdit, probe:ej2-payload-inplaceeditor-change, probe:ej2-payload-inplaceeditor-actionBegin, probe:ej2-payload-inplaceeditor-actionSuccess, probe:ej2-payload-inplaceeditor-submitClick, probe:ej2-payload-inplaceeditor-cancelClick).

Html.InputField(plan, m => m.Member).FusionInPlaceEditor(build => ..) renders FusionInPlaceEditor<TProp> bound to the member, TProp its type, its starting value the member's value read through MVC with no compile and written by M21.D1 (D17.13, N17.10, M21.X403), and its input committed by EndEdit (M7.N3); the rendered editor's Reactive(e => e.Change, pipeline) handles its events from the plan's start, their payloads typed by the member, and pipeline.Component<FusionInPlaceEditor<DateTime?>>(id) reaches a date editor from any block.
